definition: in a way that shows you are sure of yourself
sentence: She walked {confidently} onto the stage and began to sing.
translation: Она уверенно вышла на сцену и запела.

definition: a serious medical condition in which blood to the heart is blocked
sentence: He had a {coronary} at work and was rushed to hospital.
translation: У него случился инфаркт на работе, и его срочно отвезли в больницу.

definition: a department of a government or large company led by a director
sentence: She heads the {directorate} for road safety.
translation: Она возглавляет управление по безопасности дорожного движения.

definition: not active or growing now, but able to become active later
sentence: The volcano has been {dormant} for two hundred years.
translation: Вулкан бездействует уже двести лет.

definition: to give money to a school or hospital, or to give someone a quality
sentence: A rich family decided to {endow} a new library wing.
translation: Богатая семья решила пожертвовать деньги на новое крыло библиотеки.

definition: the act of avoiding something you should do, such as paying tax
sentence: The actor was jailed for tax {evasion}.
translation: Актёра посадили за уклонение от уплаты налогов.

definition: a tree or bush that keeps its green leaves all year
sentence: Pine is an {evergreen}, so the garden looks green in winter.
translation: Сосна — вечнозелёное дерево, поэтому сад зимой выглядит зелёным.

definition: the act of forcing someone to leave their home by law
sentence: The family faced {eviction} after missing three rent payments.
translation: Семье грозило выселение после трёх пропущенных платежей за жильё.

definition: the act of forcing someone to leave a school, organization or country
sentence: The student faced {expulsion} for cheating in the exam.
translation: Студенту грозило отчисление за списывание на экзамене.

definition: very dirty matter, or rude and offensive words or pictures
sentence: The kitchen was covered in grease and {filth}.
translation: Кухня была покрыта жиром и грязью.

definition: the leaves of a tree or plant
sentence: The autumn {foliage} turned the hills red and gold.
translation: Осенняя листва окрасила холмы в красный и золотой.

definition: a period of two weeks
sentence: We are going to Spain for a {fortnight} in July.
translation: Мы едем в Испанию на две недели в июле.

definition: a magic spirit in stories that can grant wishes
sentence: The {genie} came out of the lamp and offered three wishes.
translation: Джинн вышел из лампы и предложил три желания.

definition: extremely sad because someone you love has left or died
sentence: He was {heartbroken} when his dog died.
translation: Он был убит горем, когда умерла его собака.

definition: slow to act or speak because you are not sure
sentence: She was {hesitant} to sign the contract without a lawyer.
translation: Она не решалась подписать контракт без юриста.

definition: a medical condition in which the blood pressure is too high
sentence: Salt and stress can both lead to {hypertension}.
translation: И соль, и стресс могут привести к гипертонии.

definition: the state of living or being remembered for ever
sentence: The poet achieved {immortality} through a single poem.
translation: Поэт обрёл бессмертие благодаря одному стихотворению.

definition: without a clear end, limit or exact meaning
sentence: The factory closed for an {indefinite} period after the fire.
translation: Завод закрылся на неопределённый срок после пожара.

definition: showing a deep and clear understanding of something
sentence: Her {insightful} review explained why the film fails.
translation: Её проницательная рецензия объяснила, почему фильм провалился.

definition: without taking something into account; regardless
sentence: Everyone pays the same fee, {irrespective} of age.
translation: Все платят одинаковый взнос, независимо от возраста.

definition: a narrow flat shelf that sticks out from a wall or cliff
sentence: A cat sat on the window {ledge} watching the birds.
translation: Кошка сидела на подоконнике и смотрела на птиц.

definition: grain, usually barley, that has been soaked and dried for making beer
sentence: The brewery buys its {malt} from local farms.
translation: Пивоварня покупает солод у местных ферм.

definition: the practice of paying calm attention to the present moment
sentence: The clinic teaches {mindfulness} to patients with anxiety.
translation: Клиника обучает осознанности пациентов с тревожностью.

definition: extremely large, or extremely cruel and shocking
sentence: A {monstrous} wave crashed over the harbor wall.
translation: Чудовищная волна обрушилась на стену гавани.

definition: the study of the form of words, or of the shape of living things
sentence: Her thesis compares the {morphology} of Russian and Polish verbs.
translation: Её диссертация сравнивает морфологию русских и польских глаголов.

definition: hair that grows above a man's upper lip
sentence: He grew a thick {mustache} for the film role.
translation: Он отрастил густые усы для роли в фильме.

definition: the state of being equal, especially in pay or value
sentence: Women still have not reached pay {parity} with men.
translation: Женщины до сих пор не достигли равенства в оплате с мужчинами.

definition: good at making people believe or do something
sentence: Her {persuasive} speech changed several votes in the council.
translation: Её убедительная речь изменила несколько голосов в совете.

definition: having a large population
sentence: Tokyo is one of the most {populous} cities in the world.
translation: Токио — один из самых густонаселённых городов мира.

definition: happening or existing in the years after a war
sentence: The {postwar} housing boom changed the look of the suburbs.
translation: Послевоенный жилищный бум изменил облик пригородов.

definition: acting to control a situation before problems appear
sentence: A {proactive} manager fixes small problems before they grow.
translation: Инициативный менеджер решает мелкие проблемы, пока они не выросли.

definition: in a way that is easy to see or notice
sentence: The warning is printed {prominently} on the front of the box.
translation: Предупреждение напечатано на видном месте на лицевой стороне коробки.

definition: careful and wise, avoiding risks that are not needed
sentence: It is {prudent} to keep some savings for emergencies.
translation: Благоразумно держать сбережения на случай непредвиденных ситуаций.

definition: needing someone or something in order to live or work
sentence: The village is {reliant} on one bus a day.
translation: Деревня зависит от одного автобуса в день.

definition: known to be honest and good at what it does
sentence: Buy the parts only from a {reputable} dealer.
translation: Покупай запчасти только у надёжного продавца.

definition: a flat area of ice or hard floor for skating or hockey
sentence: The children spent the afternoon at the ice {rink}.
translation: Дети провели день на катке.

definition: serious and without any humor, often at a formal event
sentence: The soldiers stood in {solemn} silence at the grave.
translation: Солдаты стояли в торжественном молчании у могилы.

definition: having a lot of room inside
sentence: The flat has a {spacious} kitchen with a view of the park.
translation: В квартире просторная кухня с видом на парк.

definition: dealing with real, important matters rather than small details
sentence: The two sides made no {substantive} progress in the talks.
translation: Стороны не добились существенного прогресса на переговорах.

definition: the main part of the human body without the head, arms and legs
sentence: The statue shows only the {torso} of a young athlete.
translation: Статуя изображает лишь торс молодого атлета.

definition: very much; to a great degree
sentence: The town has grown {tremendously} since the factory opened.
translation: Город невероятно вырос с открытия завода.

definition: not yet printed or made available to the public
sentence: The museum found an {unpublished} poem in the writer's desk.
translation: Музей нашёл неопубликованное стихотворение в столе писателя.

definition: not correct or not based on facts
sentence: The story about the fire at the school was {untrue}.
translation: История о пожаре в школе была неправдой.

definition: using spoken words rather than writing or action
sentence: He agreed {verbally}, but nothing was put in writing.
translation: Он согласился на словах, но ничего не было записано.

definition: energy and the power to stay active and healthy
sentence: At eighty, my grandmother still has amazing {vitality}.
translation: В восемьдесят моя бабушка по-прежнему полна энергии.

definition: the glass window at the front of a car
sentence: A stone cracked the {windshield} on the motorway.
translation: Камень треснул лобовое стекло на автостраде.

definition: the twelve signs, named after star groups, used in astrology
sentence: Her sign of the {zodiac} is Leo, the lion.
translation: Её знак зодиака — Лев.

definition: a piece of cloth or paper used at meals to clean your lips and hands
sentence: She folded the {napkin} and laid it beside the plate.
translation: Она сложила салфетку и положила рядом с тарелкой.

definition: to find out something for certain
sentence: The police could not {ascertain} who had sent the letter.
translation: Полиция не смогла установить, кто отправил письмо.

definition: to make something look bigger, or to make a problem seem bigger
sentence: This lens can {magnify} an insect fifty times.
translation: Эта линза может увеличить насекомое в пятьдесят раз.

definition: to stop someone from doing what they planned
sentence: Quick action by the guards helped {thwart} the robbery.
translation: Быстрые действия охраны помогли сорвать ограбление.

definition: a general idea rather than a real object, or the act of forming one
sentence: Freedom is an {abstraction} until you lose it.
translation: Свобода — абстракция, пока её не потеряешь.

definition: to prevent something bad from happening, or to turn your eyes away
sentence: A last-minute deal helped {avert} the strike.
translation: Сделка в последнюю минуту помогла предотвратить забастовку.

definition: to prove that a statement or idea is wrong
sentence: The lawyer was able to {refute} every claim in the report.
translation: Адвокат смог опровергнуть каждое утверждение в отчёте.

definition: a small newspaper with short stories, big pictures and gossip
sentence: The {tabloid} printed photos of the singer's wedding.
translation: Таблоид напечатал фотографии свадьбы певицы.

definition: to cut off someone's head as a punishment
sentence: The king ordered his guards to {behead} the traitor.
translation: Король приказал страже обезглавить предателя.

definition: to say formally that you give up a right, belief or title
sentence: He had to {renounce} his old citizenship to get the new one.
translation: Ему пришлось отказаться от старого гражданства, чтобы получить новое.

definition: the hard, pointed mouth of a bird
sentence: The parrot cracked the nut with its strong {beak}.
translation: Попугай расколол орех крепким клювом.

definition: a wild pig, or a male pig
sentence: A wild {boar} ran across the forest road at dusk.
translation: Дикий кабан перебежал лесную дорогу в сумерках.

definition: to make the soft, low sound of a dove, or to speak softly and lovingly
sentence: Pigeons {coo} on the roof every morning.
translation: Голуби воркуют на крыше каждое утро.

definition: a coffee drink made with espresso and a lot of hot milk
sentence: She ordered a {latte} with oat milk and sat by the window.
translation: Она заказала латте на овсяном молоке и села у окна.

definition: to push something away or drive an attack back
sentence: The spray will {repel} mosquitoes for about four hours.
translation: Спрей будет отпугивать комаров примерно четыре часа.

definition: to become weaker or smaller over time
sentence: Public interest in the case began to {wane} after a year.
translation: Интерес публики к делу начал угасать через год.

definition: a person who plans the route of a ship or aircraft
sentence: The {navigator} checked the map and gave a new course.
translation: Штурман сверился с картой и задал новый курс.

definition: to become worn at the edge so that threads come loose
sentence: The old rope started to {fray} where it rubbed the rock.
translation: Старая верёвка начала истираться там, где тёрлась о камень.

definition: the point where two lines meet to form an angle, or the highest point
sentence: Every triangle has three sides and a {vertex} at each corner.
translation: У каждого треугольника три стороны и вершина в каждом углу.

definition: a ringing sound made by a bell or a clock
sentence: The {chime} of the church bell carried across the valley.
translation: Звон церковного колокола разносился по долине.

definition: a sword with a curved blade, also used in one kind of sport fighting
sentence: She won gold in the women's {sabre} at the Olympics.
translation: Она выиграла золото в женской сабле на Олимпиаде.

definition: to spread out over a large area, or to lie with arms and legs spread
sentence: New suburbs {sprawl} for miles beyond the old city limits.
translation: Новые пригороды раскинулись на мили за старыми границами города.

definition: a fixed plan of diet, exercise or medicine to improve health
sentence: The doctor put him on a strict {regimen} of walking and vegetables.
translation: Врач назначил ему строгий режим: ходьба и овощи.

definition: able to be worn on the body, used especially of small electronic devices
sentence: The company makes {wearable} devices that track your heartbeat.
translation: Компания делает носимые устройства, которые отслеживают пульс.

definition: to give a share of something to a person or purpose
sentence: The teacher will {allot} ten minutes to each speaker.
translation: Учитель отведёт каждому докладчику по десять минут.

definition: the part of the arm between the elbow and the wrist
sentence: He has a tattoo of a ship on his left {forearm}.
translation: У него татуировка корабля на левом предплечье.

definition: a performance of music or poetry by one person or a small group
sentence: The piano {recital} ended with a piece by Chopin.
translation: Фортепианный концерт закончился пьесой Шопена.

definition: a small, sharp piece of wood or glass broken off a larger piece
sentence: She got a {splinter} in her finger from the old bench.
translation: Она занозила палец о старую скамейку.

definition: a person who stays faithful to a ruler, party or government
sentence: The {loyalist} troops defended the palace against the rebels.
translation: Войска лоялистов защищали дворец от повстанцев.

definition: the act of leaving someone or something behind for ever
sentence: The {abandonment} of the mine left the whole town without work.
translation: Закрытие шахты оставило весь город без работы.

definition: a very deep hole that seems to have no bottom
sentence: The path ran along the edge of a dark {abyss}.
translation: Тропа шла по краю тёмной пропасти.

definition: the act of becoming king or queen, or of joining an organization
sentence: The country celebrated its {accession} to the European Union.
translation: Страна отпраздновала своё вступление в Европейский союз.

definition: the part of mathematics that deals with adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing
sentence: The children practice {arithmetic} every morning before reading.
translation: Дети упражняются в арифметике каждое утро перед чтением.

definition: the crime of deliberately setting fire to a building
sentence: The police treated the warehouse fire as {arson}.
translation: Полиция рассматривала пожар на складе как поджог.

definition: trusted because of real knowledge, or commanding respect and obedience
sentence: This is the most {authoritative} book on the history of Rome.
translation: Это самая авторитетная книга по истории Рима.

definition: unable to produce plants or crops, or unable to have children
sentence: Nothing grows on the {barren} rock of the island.
translation: На голой скале острова ничего не растёт.

definition: belonging to the middle class, especially when too concerned with money and comfort
sentence: He mocked their {bourgeois} love of big cars and clean lawns.
translation: Он высмеивал их буржуазную любовь к большим машинам и чистым газонам.

definition: the crime of giving money or gifts to make someone act dishonestly
sentence: The minister resigned after being charged with {bribery}.
translation: Министр ушёл в отставку после обвинения во взяточничестве.

definition: a woman or girl with dark brown hair
sentence: A tall {brunette} in a red coat asked for directions.
translation: Высокая брюнетка в красном пальто спросила дорогу.

definition: involving many complicated official rules and slow procedures
sentence: Getting a permit was a long and {bureaucratic} process.
translation: Получение разрешения было долгим бюрократическим процессом.

definition: an electric device that makes a loud sound as a signal
sentence: Press the {buzzer} when you know the answer.
translation: Нажми на кнопку зуммера, когда узнаешь ответ.

definition: the care of children while their parents are at work
sentence: The company offers free {childcare} to all its staff.
translation: Компания предлагает бесплатный присмотр за детьми всем сотрудникам.

definition: arranged in the order in which things happened
sentence: The exhibition shows the painter's work in {chronological} order.
translation: Выставка показывает работы художника в хронологическом порядке.

definition: to change from gas into liquid, or to make a text shorter
sentence: Steam will {condense} into drops on the cold window.
translation: Пар сконденсируется в капли на холодном окне.

definition: the slow spreading of something, such as gas, heat or ideas, through a space
sentence: The {diffusion} of the smell took only a few seconds.
translation: Запах распространился всего за несколько секунд.

definition: to feel that someone cannot be trusted
sentence: Many voters {distrust} promises made before an election.
translation: Многие избиратели не доверяют обещаниям, данным перед выборами.

definition: having the skill and energy to start and run new businesses
sentence: Her {entrepreneurial} spirit turned a small stall into a chain of shops.
translation: Её предпринимательская жилка превратила маленький лоток в сеть магазинов.

definition: a clear liquid once used in hospitals to put patients to sleep
sentence: The doctor used {ether} to put the patient to sleep.
translation: Врач использовал эфир, чтобы усыпить пациента.

definition: the set of rules about polite behavior in a group or situation
sentence: Business {etiquette} in Japan starts with the exchange of cards.
translation: Деловой этикет в Японии начинается с обмена визитками.

definition: spending or costing much more than is necessary or reasonable
sentence: They threw an {extravagant} party with fireworks and a band.
translation: Они закатили расточительную вечеринку с фейерверком и оркестром.

definition: good knowledge of something because you have seen or done it often
sentence: Her {familiarity} with the city helped us find the hotel.
translation: Её знание города помогло нам найти отель.

definition: relating to a baby that is still developing inside its mother
sentence: The scan showed normal {fetal} growth at twenty weeks.
translation: УЗИ показало нормальное развитие плода на двадцатой неделе.

definition: the man a woman has promised to marry
sentence: She introduced her {fiance} to her parents at dinner.
translation: Она представила своего жениха родителям за ужином.

definition: a large musical instrument with strings stretched on a tall frame
sentence: She played the {harp} at the wedding ceremony.
translation: Она играла на арфе на свадебной церемонии.

definition: deeply and sincerely felt
sentence: He gave a {heartfelt} apology to the family.
translation: Он искренне извинился перед семьёй.

definition: the act of including something as part of a whole, or of forming a company
sentence: The lawyer handled the {incorporation} of the new business.
translation: Юрист занимался регистрацией новой компании.

definition: very happy, or causing great happiness
sentence: The wedding was a {joyful} day for both families.
translation: Свадьба стала радостным днём для обеих семей.

definition: the start of a football game, or the start of any activity
sentence: The {kickoff} was delayed by heavy rain.
translation: Начало матча задержали из-за сильного дождя.

definition: a team game in which players catch and throw a ball with net sticks
sentence: My daughter plays {lacrosse} for her school team.
translation: Моя дочь играет в лакросс за школьную команду.

definition: a milky liquid from rubber trees, or the rubber-like material made from it
sentence: The gloves are made of {latex}, so check for an allergy.
translation: Перчатки сделаны из латекса, так что проверьте на аллергию.

definition: the act of making something legal that was against the law before
sentence: The vote on the {legalization} of the drug was very close.
translation: Голосование по легализации препарата прошло с минимальным перевесом.

definition: to limit something to one area, or to find exactly where something is
sentence: Doctors tried to {localize} the source of the pain.
translation: Врачи пытались определить место, откуда исходит боль.

definition: extremely large
sentence: Cleaning up after the flood was a {mammoth} task.
translation: Уборка после наводнения была гигантской задачей.

definition: a contest between two particular players or teams
sentence: Sunday's {matchup} between the two best teams sold out in minutes.
translation: Воскресная встреча двух лучших команд была распродана за минуты.

definition: a device that connects a computer to the internet through a phone or cable line
sentence: Restart the {modem} if the internet stops working.
translation: Перезагрузи модем, если интернет перестанет работать.

definition: suggesting that something bad is going to happen
sentence: Dark, {ominous} clouds gathered over the hills.
translation: Над холмами собрались тёмные зловещие тучи.

definition: the quality of being honest and ready to accept new ideas
sentence: The new manager was praised for her {openness} to criticism.
translation: Нового руководителя хвалили за открытость к критике.

definition: to hear what other people are saying by chance
sentence: I happened to {overhear} them planning a surprise party.
translation: Я случайно услышал, как они планируют вечеринку-сюрприз.

definition: bigger than usual or bigger than it should be
sentence: She wore an {oversize} sweater that reached her knees.
translation: На ней был свитер оверсайз до колен.

definition: relating to the Pope, the head of the Roman Catholic Church
sentence: The {papal} visit brought a million people into the square.
translation: Визит папы римского собрал на площади миллион человек.

definition: in good enough condition to be played on or with
sentence: The heavy rain left the pitch barely {playable}.
translation: После сильного дождя поле было едва пригодно для игры.

definition: elegant and expensive, often used of people and places of the upper class
sentence: They ate at a {posh} restaurant with white tablecloths.
translation: Они ужинали в шикарном ресторане с белыми скатертями.

definition: mainly; more than anything else
sentence: The town lives {principally} on tourism and fishing.
translation: Город живёт главным образом туризмом и рыбной ловлей.

definition: the skill and good behavior expected of a trained person at work
sentence: The nurses showed great {professionalism} during the crisis.
translation: Медсёстры проявили большой профессионализм во время кризиса.

definition: a period of wild, violent behavior that causes damage
sentence: The elephant went on a {rampage} through the village.
translation: Слон устроил погром в деревне.

definition: the return of something to life or success after a decline
sentence: The old port has seen a {rebirth} as a center for artists.
translation: Старый порт пережил возрождение как центр художников.

definition: to fill a battery with electricity again
sentence: Remember to {recharge} your phone before the trip.
translation: Не забудь зарядить телефон перед поездкой.

definition: in a way that can be trusted to work or be true
sentence: This old car starts {reliably} even in deep winter.
translation: Эта старая машина надёжно заводится даже в глубокую зиму.

definition: the layer at the back of the eye that senses light
sentence: Looking at the sun can damage the {retina}.
translation: Взгляд на солнце может повредить сетчатку.

definition: relating to the meaning of words and sentences
sentence: There is a small {semantic} difference between the two words.
translation: Между двумя словами есть небольшая смысловая разница.

definition: a strong wine from Spain, often drunk before a meal
sentence: My grandmother has a small glass of {sherry} before dinner.
translation: Моя бабушка выпивает рюмку хереса перед ужином.

definition: a soft rubber-like material used in kitchen tools, seals and medicine
sentence: The {silicone} baking mat does not need any oil.
translation: Силиконовый коврик для выпечки не требует масла.

definition: doubt about whether something is true or useful
sentence: The scientists met the new theory with {skepticism}.
translation: Учёные встретили новую теорию со скептицизмом.

definition: clever at tricking people in a secret way
sentence: The {sly} fox waited until the farmer was asleep.
translation: Хитрая лиса ждала, пока фермер уснёт.

definition: a small picture of a smiling face used in messages
sentence: She ended the text with a {smiley} so I knew she was joking.
translation: Она закончила сообщение смайликом, и я понял, что она шутит.

definition: angry disagreement or fighting between people or groups
sentence: Years of {strife} between the two families ended with a wedding.
translation: Годы вражды между двумя семьями закончились свадьбой.

definition: a man with a high singing voice, or the general meaning of something
sentence: The {tenor} sang the final aria to loud applause.
translation: Тенор спел финальную арию под громкие аплодисменты.

definition: careful use of money so that nothing is wasted
sentence: Her {thrift} allowed the family to buy a house on one salary.
translation: Её бережливость позволила семье купить дом на одну зарплату.

definition: a sudden change from a bad situation to a good one
sentence: The company made a remarkable {turnaround} after the new CEO arrived.
translation: Компания совершила впечатляющий разворот после прихода нового директора.

definition: the organ in a woman's body where a baby grows before birth
sentence: The scan showed a healthy baby inside the {uterus}.
translation: УЗИ показало здорового ребёнка в матке.

definition: a person whose job is to fit and repair electrical wires and equipment
sentence: Call an {electrician} before you touch that broken socket.
translation: Вызови электрика, прежде чем трогать сломанную розетку.

definition: to worry about something in a nervous way
sentence: Don't {fret} about the exam; you have studied enough.
translation: Не переживай из-за экзамена, ты достаточно готовился.

definition: to take things out of a bag or box after a journey
sentence: We arrived too tired to {unpack} the suitcases.
translation: Мы приехали слишком уставшими, чтобы разобрать чемоданы.

definition: to hold someone's attention completely because of beauty or interest
sentence: The singer managed to {captivate} the crowd with one song.
translation: Певица сумела очаровать толпу одной песней.

definition: to move water or mud around violently, or to produce things quickly and carelessly
sentence: The boat's engine began to {churn} the brown water.
translation: Двигатель лодки начал взбивать бурую воду.

definition: a substance that gives off a sweet smell when it is burned
sentence: The temple smelled of {incense} and candle wax.
translation: В храме пахло благовониями и воском свечей.

definition: the dead body of an animal
sentence: Vultures circled above the {carcass} of a deer.
translation: Грифы кружили над тушей оленя.

definition: a lot of things lying around in an untidy way
sentence: Her desk was lost under a {clutter} of papers and cups.
translation: Её стол исчез под грудой бумаг и чашек.

definition: a person from the same country as you
sentence: In the final he faced a fellow {countryman} from Lyon.
translation: В финале ему противостоял соотечественник из Лиона.

definition: a scientist who studies human societies, customs and beliefs
sentence: The {anthropologist} lived with the tribe for two years.
translation: Антрополог прожил с племенем два года.

definition: a person or group that takes part in a fight or war
sentence: Every {combatant} in the war was promised a pension.
translation: Каждому участнику боевых действий обещали пенсию.

definition: to make a bad situation, problem or feeling worse
sentence: Cutting the budget will only {exacerbate} the staff shortage.
translation: Сокращение бюджета лишь усугубит нехватку персонала.

definition: a girl or woman who helps the bride at a wedding
sentence: Each {bridesmaid} carried a small bunch of white roses.
translation: Каждая подружка невесты несла маленький букет белых роз.

definition: to leave the rails, or to make a plan or process fail
sentence: A fallen tree caused the train to {derail} near the bridge.
translation: Упавшее дерево привело к сходу поезда с рельсов у моста.

definition: a person who publicly disagrees with their government
sentence: The {dissident} spent five years in prison for his articles.
translation: Диссидент провёл пять лет в тюрьме за свои статьи.

definition: a soft, sweet, white food that is often toasted over a fire
sentence: We toasted a {marshmallow} on a stick over the campfire.
translation: Мы поджарили маршмеллоу на палочке над костром.

definition: to hold back a feeling or stop people from acting freely
sentence: He had to {repress} a smile during the serious speech.
translation: Ему пришлось сдерживать улыбку во время серьёзной речи.

definition: an electrical part that stores a charge for a short time
sentence: The flash uses a {capacitor} to release energy in an instant.
translation: Вспышка использует конденсатор, чтобы мгновенно высвободить энергию.

definition: a short form of a word or phrase, such as Dr for doctor
sentence: The report is full of an {abbreviation} on every line.
translation: Отчёт полон сокращений в каждой строке.

definition: a person who has just started doing something and has little experience
sentence: As a {newbie} at the gym, he asked the trainer for help.
translation: Как новичок в зале, он попросил тренера о помощи.

definition: to change the order or position of things
sentence: Let's {rearrange} the chairs so everyone can see the screen.
translation: Давайте переставим стулья, чтобы все видели экран.

definition: the piece of skin that covers the eye when it is closed
sentence: A tiny insect landed on her {eyelid} and she blinked.
translation: Крошечное насекомое село ей на веко, и она моргнула.

definition: a small piece of information, text or music
sentence: He played a short {snippet} of the new song on the radio.
translation: Он проиграл короткий отрывок новой песни по радио.

definition: the quality of being attractive, exciting or mysterious
sentence: The {allure} of a big city draws young people from the villages.
translation: Притягательность большого города манит молодёжь из деревень.

definition: to cover or hide something completely
sentence: Thick fog began to {shroud} the harbor by evening.
translation: К вечеру густой туман окутал гавань.

definition: a sailor, especially one who is not an officer
sentence: The young {seaman} climbed the mast in the storm.
translation: Молодой матрос взобрался на мачту в шторм.

definition: the use of drugs to stop a patient from feeling pain during an operation
sentence: The operation took an hour under general {anesthesia}.
translation: Операция длилась час под общим наркозом.

definition: the state of not being known by name
sentence: The witness asked for {anonymity} before she would talk.
translation: Свидетельница попросила об анонимности, прежде чем заговорить.

definition: not wearing anything on the feet
sentence: The children ran {barefoot} across the warm sand.
translation: Дети бежали босиком по тёплому песку.

definition: a large number of questions, complaints or attacks coming all at once
sentence: The minister faced a {barrage} of questions from reporters.
translation: Министр столкнулся с градом вопросов от репортёров.

definition: great cleverness or skill, or very bright light
sentence: The {brilliance} of the young chess player surprised everyone.
translation: Блестящий талант юного шахматиста удивил всех.

definition: a thin soup made by cooking meat or bones in water
sentence: The chicken {broth} warmed us up after the long walk.
translation: Куриный бульон согрел нас после долгой прогулки.

definition: a chemical compound of chlorine with another element, such as in salt
sentence: Table salt is a {chloride} of the metal sodium.
translation: Поваренная соль — это хлорид металла натрия.

definition: in a medical way, or in a cold way without feeling
sentence: The patient was {clinically} dead for three minutes.
translation: Пациент был клинически мёртв три минуты.

definition: too sure of yourself in a way that annoys others
sentence: The {cocky} young boxer promised to win in one round.
translation: Самоуверенный молодой боксёр обещал победить за один раунд.

definition: the most important part on which everything else depends
sentence: Trust is the {cornerstone} of any good friendship.
translation: Доверие — краеугольный камень любой хорошей дружбы.

definition: the quality of being right or without mistakes
sentence: The teacher checked the {correctness} of every answer twice.
translation: Учитель дважды проверил правильность каждого ответа.

definition: a copy of something valuable made to trick people, such as fake money
sentence: The shop refused the note because it was a {counterfeit}.
translation: Магазин отказался принять купюру, потому что она была поддельной.

definition: the medical work of looking after people's teeth
sentence: She studied {dentistry} for five years before opening her clinic.
translation: Она пять лет изучала стоматологию, прежде чем открыть клинику.

definition: nervous and easily upset, or unusual and slightly shocking in style
sentence: He was {edgy} all morning waiting for the test results.
translation: Он всё утро нервничал в ожидании результатов анализов.

definition: an extra song or piece played at the end of a show
sentence: The band came back for an {encore} after ten minutes of cheering.
translation: Группа вернулась на бис после десяти минут оваций.

definition: very much; to a very great degree
sentence: The city has changed {enormously} in the last ten years.
translation: Город колоссально изменился за последние десять лет.

definition: strong black coffee made by forcing steam through ground coffee
sentence: He drank a quick {espresso} at the bar and left.
translation: Он выпил быстрый эспрессо у стойки и ушёл.

definition: very strange and a little frightening
sentence: It was {freaky} that we both dreamed the same thing.
translation: Было жутковато, что нам обоим приснилось одно и то же.

definition: having no chance of success; useless
sentence: It is {futile} to argue with him once he has decided.
translation: Бесполезно спорить с ним, когда он уже решил.

definition: extremely cold, or extremely slow, or relating to ice masses
sentence: A {glacial} wind blew across the empty car park.
translation: Ледяной ветер дул по пустой парковке.

definition: dark and sad, without hope
sentence: The flat looks {gloomy} on rainy days.
translation: В дождливые дни квартира выглядит мрачно.

definition: moving in a smooth and beautiful way
sentence: The swan made a {graceful} turn on the water.
translation: Лебедь грациозно развернулся на воде.

definition: showing courage and determination, or showing unpleasant things honestly
sentence: The film is a {gritty} story of life on the streets.
translation: Фильм — суровая история о жизни на улицах.

definition: very great sadness, especially after losing someone you love
sentence: The song is about the {heartbreak} of her first divorce.
translation: Песня о боли от её первого развода.

definition: a robbery of a bank, shop or vehicle, usually carefully planned
sentence: The gang planned the diamond {heist} for over a year.
translation: Банда больше года планировала ограбление с бриллиантами.

definition: sexually attracted to people of the opposite sex
sentence: The survey asked whether people were {heterosexual}, gay or bisexual.
translation: Опрос спрашивал, гетеросексуальны ли люди, геи или бисексуалы.

definition: the back of a horse, when someone is riding it
sentence: The police patrol the park on {horseback} at weekends.
translation: По выходным полиция патрулирует парк верхом.

definition: a hospital where people who are dying are cared for
sentence: Her father spent his last weeks in a {hospice} by the sea.
translation: Её отец провёл последние недели в хосписе у моря.

definition: involving two or more different areas of study
sentence: The {interdisciplinary} course mixes biology, law and economics.
translation: Междисциплинарный курс сочетает биологию, право и экономику.

definition: stopping and starting again at intervals; not continuous
sentence: The forecast says {intermittent} rain until Thursday.
translation: Прогноз обещает периодические дожди до четверга.

definition: the act of frightening someone so that they do what you want
sentence: Witnesses refused to speak because of {intimidation} by the gang.
translation: Свидетели отказались говорить из-за запугивания со стороны банды.

definition: a short saying that gives a rule for good behavior
sentence: Her favorite {maxim} is: never put off until tomorrow.
translation: Её любимая максима: никогда не откладывай на завтра.

definition: a deep sadness that lasts for a long time
sentence: A quiet {melancholy} hung over the empty house.
translation: Тихая грусть висела над пустым домом.

definition: relating to the study of the weather
sentence: The {meteorological} office issued a storm warning for the coast.
translation: Метеослужба выпустила штормовое предупреждение для побережья.

definition: to put something somewhere and then forget where it is
sentence: I always {misplace} my keys when I am in a hurry.
translation: Я вечно куда-то деваю ключи, когда спешу.

definition: with a thin cloud of tiny water drops in the air
sentence: It was a {misty} morning, and the far bank was invisible.
translation: Утро было туманным, и дальний берег был не виден.

definition: including people of many different cultures and backgrounds
sentence: The school is proud of its {multicultural} mix of students.
translation: Школа гордится многонациональным составом учеников.

definition: so small that it is not worth considering
sentence: The extra cost is {negligible} compared to the total.
translation: Дополнительные расходы ничтожны по сравнению с общей суммой.

definition: the state of wearing no clothes
sentence: The film contains some {nudity} and is not for children.
translation: В фильме есть сцены с обнажёнными телами, он не для детей.

definition: required by a rule or law; something you must do
sentence: Wearing a helmet is {obligatory} on this building site.
translation: Ношение каски обязательно на этой стройке.

definition: relating to the ocean
sentence: The {oceanic} crust is thinner than the rock under the continents.
translation: Океаническая кора тоньше, чем порода под континентами.

definition: the process in which a substance combines with oxygen, as when iron rusts
sentence: Rust is the {oxidation} of iron in damp air.
translation: Ржавчина — это окисление железа во влажном воздухе.

definition: a wide view of a large area of land or sea
sentence: From the tower you get a {panorama} of the whole valley.
translation: С башни открывается панорама всей долины.

definition: present or felt everywhere in a place or thing
sentence: There was a {pervasive} smell of smoke in the old bar.
translation: В старом баре стоял всепроникающий запах дыма.

definition: living by killing other animals, or using weaker people for your own gain
sentence: The hawk is a {predatory} bird that hunts mice and small birds.
translation: Ястреб — хищная птица, которая охотится на мышей и мелких птиц.

definition: an introduction at the beginning of a book that explains its purpose
sentence: The author thanks her teachers in the {preface}.
translation: В предисловии автор благодарит своих учителей.

definition: meant as a punishment, often a hard one
sentence: The court ordered {punitive} damages of a million dollars.
translation: Суд назначил штрафные убытки в миллион долларов.

definition: alive or active again after a period of decline
sentence: The club felt {reborn} after promotion to the top league.
translation: Клуб словно возродился после выхода в высшую лигу.

definition: slightly red in color
sentence: The soil in this region has a {reddish} color from the iron.
translation: Почва в этом регионе красноватая из-за железа.

definition: to clean, repair and decorate a building or piece of furniture
sentence: The council plans to {refurbish} the old swimming pool.
translation: Совет планирует отремонтировать старый бассейн.

definition: a bad effect that something has, often for a long time
sentence: The scandal had a {repercussion} for every politician in the party.
translation: Скандал имел последствия для каждого политика в партии.

definition: having a regular repeated pattern of sounds or movements
sentence: The {rhythmic} beat of the drums could be heard across the water.
translation: Ритмичный бой барабанов был слышен через воду.

definition: a gambling game in which a ball is dropped onto a spinning wheel with numbers
sentence: He lost all his holiday money at {roulette}.
translation: Он проиграл все отпускные в рулетку.

definition: a soft material that shines, used for dresses and bed covers
sentence: The bride wore a dress of white {satin}.
translation: Невеста была в платье из белого атласа.

definition: to keep one group of people or things separate from the rest
sentence: In those years the law would {segregate} black and white passengers.
translation: В те годы закон разделял чёрных и белых пассажиров.

definition: the study of meaning in language
sentence: We argued about {semantics} instead of solving the real problem.
translation: Мы спорили о значениях слов вместо решения настоящей проблемы.

definition: doing bad things without feeling embarrassed or sorry
sentence: The ad was a {shameless} copy of a famous film scene.
translation: Реклама была бесстыдной копией знаменитой сцены из фильма.

definition: relating to the bones of the body, or extremely thin
sentence: The {skeletal} remains were over a thousand years old.
translation: Останкам скелета было больше тысячи лет.

definition: shaped like a ball
sentence: The Earth is not perfectly {spherical}; it is slightly flat at the poles.
translation: Земля не идеально шарообразна, она слегка сплюснута у полюсов.

definition: a tall evergreen tree with short needles, often used as a Christmas tree
sentence: We bought a small {spruce} and decorated it with lights.
translation: Мы купили маленькую ель и украсили её гирляндами.

definition: the physical or mental strength to continue doing something for a long time
sentence: Marathon runners need great {stamina} more than speed.
translation: Марафонцам нужна не столько скорость, сколько выносливость.

definition: relating to thoughts and feelings you are not aware of but that affect you
sentence: He had a {subconscious} fear of water after the accident.
translation: После аварии у него был подсознательный страх воды.

definition: a bitter fizzy drink often mixed with gin, or a medicine that gives energy
sentence: She ordered a gin and {tonic} with a slice of lime.
translation: Она заказала джин с тоником и ломтиком лайма.

definition: causing problems or difficulty over a period of time
sentence: A {troublesome} knee kept him out of the team for a month.
translation: Проблемное колено не пускало его в команду месяц.

definition: an imaginary perfect world where everyone is happy
sentence: The novel describes a {utopia} without money or war.
translation: Роман описывает утопию без денег и войн.

definition: with a lot of energy and force
sentence: The dog shook itself {vigorously} after the swim.
translation: Собака энергично отряхнулась после купания.

definition: in a way that can be clearly seen
sentence: She was {visibly} upset when she left the meeting.
translation: Она была заметно расстроена, когда вышла с собрания.

definition: a substance that makes the body produce antibodies to fight it
sentence: The test looks for a viral {antigen} in the blood.
translation: Тест ищет в крови вирусный антиген.

definition: an object shaped like a ball, especially a bright one like the sun or moon
sentence: A pale {orb} of moon rose over the sea.
translation: Бледный шар луны поднялся над морем.

definition: a unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter
sentence: The screw is only one {millimeter} too long.
translation: Винт всего на один миллиметр длиннее, чем нужно.

definition: to practice boxing with a partner without hitting hard
sentence: The champion will {spar} with three partners before the fight.
translation: Чемпион будет спарринговать с тремя партнёрами перед боем.

definition: a wide board that you stand on to slide down snowy slopes
sentence: He learned to ride a {snowboard} at the age of six.
translation: Он научился кататься на сноуборде в шесть лет.

definition: to send a person back to prison to wait for their trial
sentence: The judge decided to {remand} the suspect in custody for a month.
translation: Судья решил оставить подозреваемого под стражей на месяц.

definition: to experience something again in your mind
sentence: Every night he would {relive} the moment of the crash.
translation: Каждую ночь он заново переживал момент аварии.

definition: to change something or yourself so much that it seems completely new
sentence: The singer managed to {reinvent} herself as a film director.
translation: Певица сумела перевоплотиться в кинорежиссёра.

definition: to say something suddenly and loudly because of surprise or strong feeling
sentence: "It's snowing!" she was the first to {exclaim}.
translation: «Снег идёт!» — первой воскликнула она.

definition: to know that something will happen before it does
sentence: Nobody could {foresee} the traffic jam on a Sunday.
translation: Никто не мог предвидеть пробку в воскресенье.

definition: a person who helps two sides reach an agreement
sentence: The bank acted as an {intermediary} between the buyer and the seller.
translation: Банк выступил посредником между покупателем и продавцом.

definition: a man who plays sport, especially one who plays fairly
sentence: He was a true {sportsman} who shook hands after every defeat.
translation: Он был настоящим спортсменом и жал руку после каждого поражения.

definition: a person who is skilled at planning how to achieve goals
sentence: The party hired a {strategist} to run the campaign.
translation: Партия наняла стратега для ведения кампании.

definition: a slow land animal with a hard shell on its back
sentence: The {tortoise} in the garden is older than my grandfather.
translation: Черепаха в саду старше моего дедушки.

definition: to force someone out of a job or position of power
sentence: The board voted to {oust} the chairman after the losses.
translation: Совет проголосовал за смещение председателя после убытков.

definition: to catch a person or animal that escaped, or to get a feeling back
sentence: The police managed to {recapture} both prisoners within a day.
translation: Полиция сумела снова поймать обоих заключённых за день.

definition: to run slowly with short steps, used of a horse or a person
sentence: The horses began to {trot} along the beach.
translation: Лошади пустились рысью вдоль пляжа.

definition: to clear mud and sand from the bottom of a river or harbor
sentence: Ships could not enter until workers began to {dredge} the channel.
translation: Суда не могли войти, пока рабочие не начали углублять канал.

definition: a detailed written study of one small subject
sentence: Her {monograph} on medieval bread took ten years to write.
translation: Её монография о средневековом хлебе писалась десять лет.

definition: a sudden strong expression of a feeling, especially anger
sentence: His angry {outburst} shocked everyone at the table.
translation: Его гневная вспышка шокировала всех за столом.

definition: a person who has committed a serious crime
sentence: As a convicted {felon}, he could not own a gun.
translation: Как осуждённый за тяжкое преступление, он не мог владеть оружием.

definition: a conclusion you reach from facts and reasoning
sentence: From the wet streets we drew the {inference} that it had rained.
translation: По мокрым улицам мы сделали вывод, что прошёл дождь.

definition: a brightly colored spring flower shaped like a cup, grown from a bulb
sentence: Every {tulip} in the park opened in the same week.
translation: Все тюльпаны в парке распустились в одну неделю.

definition: a dried grape, small, dark and sweet
sentence: She picked every {raisin} out of her cake.
translation: Она выковыряла из торта весь изюм.

definition: the extra power produced when two things work together
sentence: The merger created a {synergy} between the two sales teams.
translation: Слияние создало синергию между двумя отделами продаж.

definition: to move around quickly and busily
sentence: Waiters {bustle} between the tables all evening.
translation: Официанты весь вечер снуют между столиками.

definition: a person who loves something or someone very much
sentence: He is a {devotee} of old black-and-white films.
translation: Он страстный поклонник старых чёрно-белых фильмов.

definition: an important church ceremony, such as baptism or marriage
sentence: Baptism is the first {sacrament} a Christian receives.
translation: Крещение — первое таинство, которое получает христианин.

definition: sudden and not expected, or short and unfriendly in manner
sentence: The bus came to an {abrupt} stop in the middle of the road.
translation: Автобус резко остановился посреди дороги.

definition: a difficult or unlucky situation
sentence: She showed great courage in the face of {adversity}.
translation: Она проявила большое мужество перед лицом невзгод.

definition: a written statement that you swear is true, for use in court
sentence: The witness signed an {affidavit} about what she saw.
translation: Свидетельница подписала письменные показания под присягой о том, что видела.

definition: the belief that the stars and planets affect people's lives
sentence: She reads her {astrology} forecast every morning.
translation: Она каждое утро читает астрологический прогноз.

definition: relating to the story of a person's life
sentence: The film is a {biographical} drama about a jazz singer.
translation: Фильм — биографическая драма о джазовой певице.

definition: plant and animal material burned as fuel
sentence: The plant burns {biomass} from local farms to make electricity.
translation: Станция сжигает биомассу с местных ферм для получения электричества.

definition: a loose shirt for women or girls
sentence: She wore a white {blouse} with a dark skirt to the interview.
translation: На собеседование она надела белую блузку с тёмной юбкой.

definition: the scientific study of plants
sentence: He switched from chemistry to {botany} in his second year.
translation: На втором курсе он перешёл с химии на ботанику.

definition: the act of damaging someone's good name by saying false things
sentence: The actor sued the newspaper for {defamation}.
translation: Актёр подал на газету в суд за клевету.

definition: relating to or showing the direction something moves or points
sentence: A {directional} microphone picks up sound from one side only.
translation: Направленный микрофон улавливает звук только с одной стороны.

definition: different from each other and moving further apart
sentence: The two experts gave {divergent} opinions on the cause.
translation: Два эксперта дали расходящиеся мнения о причине.

definition: the highest degree given by a university
sentence: She received her {doctorate} in physics at twenty-six.
translation: Она получила докторскую степень по физике в двадцать шесть.

definition: completely; used to emphasize something bad
sentence: Some of the comments were {downright} rude.
translation: Некоторые комментарии были откровенно грубыми.

definition: the way information is changed into a form that computers can store or send
sentence: The file opened as nonsense because of the wrong {encoding}.
translation: Файл открылся абракадаброй из-за неправильной кодировки.

definition: so good that it is an example for others to follow
sentence: The soldier received a medal for {exemplary} courage.
translation: Солдат получил медаль за образцовое мужество.

definition: covering a wide area or a wide range of subjects
sentence: The hotel has an {expansive} view over the whole bay.
translation: Из отеля открывается широкий вид на всю бухту.

definition: large and filling, used of a meal, or warm and friendly
sentence: We had a {hearty} breakfast of eggs, beans and toast.
translation: Мы плотно позавтракали яйцами, фасолью и тостами.

definition: wild uncontrolled fear or excitement in a person or a crowd
sentence: The rumor of a shark caused {hysteria} on the beach.
translation: Слух об акуле вызвал истерию на пляже.

definition: not supporting one side more than another; fair
sentence: A judge must remain {impartial} during the trial.
translation: Судья должен оставаться беспристрастным во время процесса.

definition: the policy of one country taking control of others to build an empire
sentence: The museum has a room on the history of British {imperialism}.
translation: В музее есть зал по истории британского империализма.

definition: happening in small regular steps rather than all at once
sentence: The company prefers {incremental} changes to big reforms.
translation: Компания предпочитает постепенные изменения большим реформам.

definition: the time when someone is a baby, or the early stage of something
sentence: The project is still in its {infancy}, with no products yet.
translation: Проект пока в зачаточном состоянии, продуктов ещё нет.

definition: to write or cut words onto a surface such as stone or metal
sentence: They decided to {inscribe} her name on the back of the watch.
translation: Они решили выгравировать её имя на обратной стороне часов.

definition: extremely large, especially of a size of product
sentence: We bought a {jumbo} pack of nappies for the twins.
translation: Мы купили огромную упаковку подгузников для близнецов.

definition: a dark green vegetable with curly leaves, related to cabbage
sentence: She makes a smoothie with {kale}, apple and lemon.
translation: Она делает смузи из капусты кейл, яблока и лимона.

definition: easy enough to deal with or control
sentence: The pile of work looked {manageable} once we made a list.
translation: Гора работы стала выглядеть посильной, когда мы составили список.

definition: the crime of killing a person without meaning to
sentence: The driver was found guilty of {manslaughter}, not murder.
translation: Водителя признали виновным в непредумышленном убийстве, а не в убийстве.

definition: having many mountains
sentence: The train crosses a {mountainous} region in the north.
translation: Поезд пересекает гористый район на севере.

definition: extremely rude and unpleasant to be with
sentence: An {obnoxious} customer shouted at the waiter for ten minutes.
translation: Отвратительный клиент десять минут кричал на официанта.

definition: a home for children whose parents are dead or cannot care for them
sentence: She grew up in an {orphanage} and never knew her mother.
translation: Она выросла в детском доме и никогда не знала матери.

definition: clearly and simply; in a way that is easy to see or understand
sentence: He was {plainly} lying, but nobody said anything.
translation: Он явно лгал, но никто ничего не сказал.

definition: severe punishment for something very wrong that someone has done
sentence: The families demanded {retribution} for the attack.
translation: Семьи требовали возмездия за нападение.

definition: asked only for effect, without expecting an answer; or relating to speaking well
sentence: "Who cares?" was a {rhetorical} question; he did not want a reply.
translation: «Кому какое дело?» — вопрос был риторическим, ответа он не ждал.

definition: having a legal or moral right to something
sentence: The painting was returned to its {rightful} owner after the war.
translation: Картину вернули законному владельцу после войны.

definition: the liquid from a man's body that contains sperm
sentence: The clinic stores {semen} for couples who want children later.
translation: Клиника хранит сперму для пар, которые хотят детей позже.

definition: coming after fifteen others in order
sentence: Her {sixteenth} birthday party was held in the garden.
translation: Её шестнадцатый день рождения отметили в саду.

definition: a thick, wet substance that is not nice to touch, like on a frog
sentence: Green {slime} covered the rocks at the edge of the pond.
translation: Зелёная слизь покрывала камни у края пруда.

definition: the right to vote in political elections
sentence: Women won the {suffrage} in New Zealand in 1893.
translation: Женщины получили избирательное право в Новой Зеландии в 1893 году.

definition: a short description of the main events of a book, film or play
sentence: The back cover gives a {synopsis} of the plot.
translation: На задней обложке дано краткое содержание сюжета.

definition: a small brush with a long handle for cleaning your teeth
sentence: Change your {toothbrush} every three months.
translation: Меняй зубную щётку каждые три месяца.

definition: up a slope towards higher ground
sentence: The last mile of the race goes {uphill} to the castle.
translation: Последняя миля гонки идёт в гору к замку.

definition: the fact of changing often or of being different in different cases
sentence: The {variability} of the weather makes farming here risky.
translation: Изменчивость погоды делает земледелие здесь рискованным.

definition: a slow, graceful dance for couples with three beats to the bar
sentence: The couple opened the ball with a Viennese {waltz}.
translation: Пара открыла бал венским вальсом.

definition: to breathe loudly through the nose and mouth while sleeping
sentence: I could not sleep because my roommate began to {snore}.
translation: Я не мог уснуть, потому что сосед по комнате захрапел.

definition: a person who leaves a group or belief and turns against it
sentence: The {renegade} general led a revolt against his own army.
translation: Генерал-отступник возглавил восстание против собственной армии.

definition: a person who wants their region to become an independent country
sentence: The {separatist} movement held a march through the capital.
translation: Движение сепаратистов провело марш по столице.

definition: a very small, thin branch of a tree or bush
sentence: A {twig} snapped under his boot in the silent forest.
translation: Веточка хрустнула под его сапогом в тихом лесу.

definition: to hunt animals illegally, or to cook food gently in water
sentence: Hunters {poach} elephants for their ivory.
translation: Браконьеры незаконно убивают слонов ради бивней.

definition: to have the opposite effect to the one you wanted
sentence: The plan to scare the thieves could {backfire} badly.
translation: План напугать воров мог обернуться против нас.

definition: the wide part of a river where it meets the sea
sentence: Thousands of birds feed in the {estuary} at low tide.
translation: Тысячи птиц кормятся в устье реки во время отлива.

definition: to dig a hole in the ground, especially to find old buildings or objects
sentence: The team will {excavate} the site of the Roman villa next summer.
translation: Команда будет раскапывать место римской виллы следующим летом.

definition: a large decorated light that hangs from the ceiling with many branches
sentence: A crystal {chandelier} hung over the hotel staircase.
translation: Хрустальная люстра висела над лестницей отеля.

definition: a large feather, or a long cloud of smoke or dust rising into the air
sentence: A {plume} of black smoke rose from the burning factory.
translation: Столб чёрного дыма поднимался над горящим заводом.

definition: to hit something hard with your fist or a heavy object, making a dull sound
sentence: He began to {thump} the door with both fists.
translation: Он принялся колотить в дверь обоими кулаками.

definition: to burn the surface of something so that it changes color
sentence: Be careful not to {scorch} the shirt with the hot iron.
translation: Осторожно, не подпали рубашку горячим утюгом.

definition: a small flat block with dots on it, used in a table game
sentence: The last {domino} fell and the whole line went down.
translation: Последняя костяшка домино упала, и вся линия рухнула.

definition: a place with wireless internet, or a place where something dangerous happens often
sentence: The cafe is a free Wi-Fi {hotspot} for students.
translation: Кафе — бесплатная точка Wi-Fi для студентов.

definition: a small ape with very long arms that lives in trees in Asia
sentence: A {gibbon} swung from branch to branch high above us.
translation: Гиббон перелетал с ветки на ветку высоко над нами.

definition: a flat shape with four straight sides and four right angles
sentence: Draw a {rectangle} twice as long as it is wide.
translation: Нарисуй прямоугольник вдвое длиннее, чем шире.

definition: a large piece of heavy cloth with pictures woven into it, hung on a wall
sentence: A medieval {tapestry} of a hunt covered the castle wall.
translation: Средневековый гобелен с охотой закрывал стену замка.

definition: to emphasize or show the importance of something
sentence: The report serves to {underscore} the need for better roads.
translation: Доклад подчёркивает необходимость лучших дорог.

definition: to kill some animals of a group to reduce their number
sentence: Farmers were ordered to {cull} the infected birds.
translation: Фермерам приказали уничтожить заражённых птиц.

definition: to flow slowly in a thin stream, or to arrive in small numbers
sentence: Water began to {trickle} down the kitchen wall.
translation: Вода начала стекать тонкой струйкой по стене кухни.

definition: to put too many people or things into a space
sentence: The new flats will {overcrowd} the only school in the area.
translation: Новые квартиры переполнят единственную школу в районе.

definition: a very small creature like a spider that lives in dust, food or on animals
sentence: A tiny {mite} can live in the dust of a mattress.
translation: Крошечный клещ может жить в пыли матраса.

definition: to make something widely known to the public
sentence: The charity used social media to {publicize} the concert.
translation: Благотворительная организация использовала соцсети, чтобы рассказать о концерте.

definition: having a lot of money and a good standard of living
sentence: They moved to an {affluent} suburb with large gardens.
translation: Они переехали в богатый пригород с большими садами.

definition: the state of having more than one possible meaning
sentence: The {ambiguity} of the contract led to a long dispute.
translation: Двусмысленность контракта привела к долгому спору.

definition: extreme mental or physical pain
sentence: The mother waited in {anguish} for news of her son.
translation: Мать в мучительной тревоге ждала вестей о сыне.

definition: a written record of events year by year
sentence: The flood went down in the {annals} of the town as the worst ever.
translation: Наводнение вошло в летопись города как самое страшное.

definition: relating to laws that stop companies from controlling a whole market unfairly
sentence: The company faces an {antitrust} investigation over its prices.
translation: Компания столкнулась с антимонопольным расследованием из-за цен.

definition: very dry, with little or no rain
sentence: Few plants survive in the {arid} center of the country.
translation: Мало растений выживает в засушливом центре страны.

definition: a market, especially in the Middle East, with many small shops
sentence: We bought spices and carpets in the old {bazaar}.
translation: Мы купили специи и ковры на старом базаре.

definition: supported by two political parties that usually oppose each other
sentence: The bill passed with {bipartisan} support in the Senate.
translation: Законопроект прошёл в Сенате при поддержке обеих партий.

definition: the place where a person was born, or where something began
sentence: The village is famous as the {birthplace} of the poet.
translation: Деревня известна как родина поэта.

definition: a company that buys and sells shares or property for customers
sentence: She opened an account with an online {brokerage}.
translation: Она открыла счёт в онлайн-брокерской компании.

definition: a gradual increase in amount, or the period of preparation before an event
sentence: A {buildup} of fat in the pipe blocked the sink.
translation: Скопление жира в трубе забило раковину.

definition: a hard silver-white metal used in batteries and blue paint
sentence: Most of the world's {cobalt} for batteries comes from one country.
translation: Большая часть мирового кобальта для аккумуляторов добывается в одной стране.

definition: extremely large
sentence: The dam was a {colossal} project that took twenty years.
translation: Плотина была колоссальным проектом, занявшим двадцать лет.

definition: pleasantly hard and dry on the outside, breaking easily when bitten
sentence: The chicken skin was golden and {crispy}.
translation: Куриная кожица была золотистой и хрустящей.

definition: a rule that people must stay indoors after a certain time
sentence: The army imposed a {curfew} from nine at night until dawn.
translation: Армия ввела комендантский час с девяти вечера до рассвета.

definition: definitely and clearly
sentence: The second half of the book is {decidedly} better than the first.
translation: Вторая половина книги определённо лучше первой.

definition: the fall in the value of something over time
sentence: The {depreciation} of a new car begins the moment you drive it home.
translation: Обесценивание новой машины начинается в момент, когда вы едете на ней домой.

definition: a feeling of not being satisfied with your situation
sentence: Low pay caused growing {discontent} among the nurses.
translation: Низкая зарплата вызывала растущее недовольство среди медсестёр.

definition: a chemical in the brain linked to pleasure, reward and movement
sentence: Social media apps are designed to give small hits of {dopamine}.
translation: Приложения соцсетей спроектированы так, чтобы давать маленькие порции дофамина.

definition: made up of many different styles, ideas or sources
sentence: The restaurant has an {eclectic} menu from Thai to Italian.
translation: В ресторане эклектичное меню от тайской кухни до итальянской.

definition: extremely happy and excited
sentence: The fans were {ecstatic} when the team scored in the last minute.
translation: Болельщики были в восторге, когда команда забила на последней минуте.

definition: found regularly in a particular place, used of a disease or problem
sentence: Malaria is {endemic} in the lowlands of the region.
translation: Малярия эндемична для низменностей региона.

definition: giving off bright light, or very bright in color
sentence: The office is lit by cold {fluorescent} tubes.
translation: Офис освещён холодными люминесцентными лампами.

definition: looking or seeming to belong to the future
sentence: The {futuristic} building looks like a silver spaceship.
translation: Футуристическое здание выглядит как серебряный космический корабль.

definition: too much speed in doing something, often causing mistakes
sentence: In her {haste} to leave, she forgot her passport.
translation: В спешке, уходя, она забыла паспорт.

definition: able to be recognized or named
sentence: The thief was {identifiable} from his tattoo on the video.
translation: Вора можно было опознать по татуировке на видео.

definition: unable to read or write
sentence: Half the villagers were {illiterate} when the school opened.
translation: Половина жителей деревни была неграмотной, когда открылась школа.

definition: perfectly clean, tidy or without any mistakes
sentence: His white shirt was {immaculate} even after the long trip.
translation: Его белая рубашка была безупречна даже после долгой поездки.

definition: to be present in large numbers and cause damage, used of insects or animals
sentence: Rats began to {infest} the old grain store.
translation: Крысы заполонили старое зернохранилище.

definition: relating to the relationships and communication between people
sentence: Good {interpersonal} skills matter more than grades in this job.
translation: Навыки общения в этой работе важнее оценок.

definition: involving people of different races
sentence: Their {interracial} marriage was illegal in some states until 1967.
translation: Их межрасовый брак был незаконным в некоторых штатах до 1967 года.

definition: directed towards the inside or towards your own thoughts and feelings
sentence: She gave an {inward} sigh and kept smiling at the guests.
translation: Она внутренне вздохнула и продолжила улыбаться гостям.

definition: the state of being allowed by law
sentence: Lawyers questioned the {legality} of the new tax.
translation: Юристы поставили под сомнение законность нового налога.

definition: the length of time that a person, animal or thing lives or works
sentence: The average {lifespan} of a cat is about fifteen years.
translation: Средняя продолжительность жизни кошки около пятнадцати лет.

definition: running along the length of something, or studying the same people over many years
sentence: The {longitudinal} study followed the children for forty years.
translation: Продолжительное исследование наблюдало за детьми сорок лет.

definition: the qualities thought to be typical of men
sentence: The film questions old ideas of {masculinity} and strength.
translation: Фильм ставит под вопрос старые представления о мужественности и силе.

definition: so small that it can only be seen with a microscope
sentence: The water is full of {microscopic} life.
translation: Вода полна микроскопической жизни.

definition: the middle of the day; twelve o'clock
sentence: By {midday} the sun was too hot to work outside.
translation: К полудню солнце стало слишком жарким, чтобы работать на улице.

definition: a strong drug made from opium, used to stop severe pain
sentence: The nurse gave him {morphine} after the operation.
translation: Медсестра дала ему морфин после операции.

definition: the state of being a mother
sentence: She wrote a funny book about her first year of {motherhood}.
translation: Она написала смешную книгу о первом годе материнства.

definition: likely to kill, or extremely dangerous and violent
sentence: He gave his brother a {murderous} look across the table.
translation: Он бросил на брата убийственный взгляд через стол.

definition: a state of perfect peace and happiness, in Buddhism the end of all suffering
sentence: For a music lover, the festival was pure {nirvana}.
translation: Для любителя музыки фестиваль был чистой нирваной.

definition: without any stops or breaks
sentence: There is a {nonstop} flight from Berlin to Tokyo.
translation: Есть беспосадочный рейс из Берлина в Токио.

definition: in a way that is famous for something bad
sentence: The mountain road is {notoriously} dangerous in winter.
translation: Горная дорога печально известна своей опасностью зимой.

definition: a hot breakfast food made by cooking crushed oats in milk or water
sentence: A bowl of {oatmeal} with honey keeps me full until lunch.
translation: Миска овсянки с мёдом насыщает меня до обеда.

definition: not letting light through, or hard to understand
sentence: The bathroom window is made of {opaque} glass.
translation: Окно в ванной сделано из матового стекла.

definition: relating to the bones between the hips at the bottom of the body
sentence: The fall caused a serious {pelvic} injury.
translation: Падение привело к серьёзной травме таза.

definition: musical instruments that you hit or shake, such as drums
sentence: She plays {percussion} in the school orchestra.
translation: Она играет на ударных в школьном оркестре.

definition: a politician who claims to speak for ordinary people against the elite
sentence: The {populist} promised to lower taxes and punish the bankers.
translation: Популист обещал снизить налоги и наказать банкиров.

definition: having many tiny holes that let water or air pass through
sentence: The {porous} rock soaks up rain like a sponge.
translation: Пористая порода впитывает дождь, как губка.

definition: able to tell what will probably happen in the future
sentence: The app uses {predictive} text to guess your next word.
translation: Приложение использует предиктивный ввод, чтобы угадать следующее слово.

definition: in a way that relates to race
sentence: The city is {racially} mixed, with no single majority group.
translation: Город смешан в расовом отношении, без единой группы большинства.

definition: an official who keeps records of births, deaths, marriages or students
sentence: The {registrar} signed the marriage certificate.
translation: Регистратор подписал свидетельство о браке.

definition: simple and plain, in the style of the country rather than the city
sentence: The restaurant has a {rustic} style with wooden tables and stone walls.
translation: У ресторана деревенский стиль с деревянными столами и каменными стенами.

definition: clean and free from bacteria; relating to health and cleanliness
sentence: The camp had no {sanitary} facilities, not even clean water.
translation: В лагере не было санитарных условий, даже чистой воды.

definition: the state of being so full that nothing more can be added
sentence: The market has reached {saturation}; nobody needs another phone.
translation: Рынок достиг насыщения, никому не нужен ещё один телефон.

definition: a situation in which there is not enough of something
sentence: The {scarcity} of water forced the farmers to leave.
translation: Нехватка воды вынудила фермеров уехать.

definition: fairly large
sentence: She left a {sizable} tip for the waiter.
translation: Она оставила официанту немалые чаевые.

definition: very simple, with no comfort or luxury
sentence: The monks lived in {spartan} rooms with a bed and a chair.
translation: Монахи жили в спартанских комнатах с кроватью и стулом.

definition: a soft substance that you put on a brush to clean your teeth
sentence: We ran out of {toothpaste} on the second day of the trip.
translation: На второй день поездки у нас закончилась зубная паста.

definition: lasting only a short time; passing quickly
sentence: The town has a {transient} population of students and seasonal workers.
translation: В городе временное население из студентов и сезонных рабочих.

definition: feeling or showing great joy after a victory
sentence: The {triumphant} team paraded through the city on an open bus.
translation: Торжествующая команда проехала по городу на открытом автобусе.

definition: not yet born
sentence: The scan showed the {unborn} baby moving its hands.
translation: На УЗИ было видно, как ещё не родившийся ребёнок двигает руками.

definition: not made known to the public
sentence: The player signed for an {undisclosed} fee.
translation: Игрок перешёл за нераскрытую сумму.

definition: not listened to, or so unusual that it has never happened before
sentence: Her warning went {unheard} in the noise of the meeting.
translation: Её предупреждение осталось неуслышанным в шуме собрания.

definition: a priest in charge of a church area in the Church of England
sentence: The {vicar} visits the old people of the village every week.
translation: Викарий навещает стариков деревни каждую неделю.

definition: very unhappy or in very poor condition
sentence: The refugees lived in {wretched} tents through the winter.
translation: Беженцы всю зиму жили в убогих палатках.

definition: a statement that something is true, or a positive sentence you repeat to yourself
sentence: The judge's decision was an {affirmation} of her rights.
translation: Решение судьи стало подтверждением её прав.

definition: a drug or device that prevents a woman from becoming pregnant
sentence: The clinic gives free advice on every type of {contraceptive}.
translation: Клиника даёт бесплатные консультации по всем видам контрацептивов.

definition: a structure of poles and boards for workers to stand on while building
sentence: Workers climbed the {scaffold} to repair the roof.
translation: Рабочие поднялись на леса, чтобы починить крышу.

definition: to talk for a long time in a confused way, or to walk for pleasure
sentence: Grandpa tends to {ramble} about the war after a glass of wine.
translation: После бокала вина дедушка любит бессвязно рассказывать о войне.

definition: a disease that kills plants, or something that spoils or damages
sentence: The potato {blight} destroyed the whole harvest in 1845.
translation: Картофельная болезнь уничтожила весь урожай в 1845 году.

definition: a small, active dog originally bred to hunt small animals
sentence: Our {terrier} digs holes all over the garden.
translation: Наш терьер роет ямы по всему саду.

definition: a small ball of chopped meat, cooked and often served with sauce
sentence: The pasta came with a {meatball} the size of my fist.
translation: Паста пришла с фрикаделькой размером с мой кулак.

definition: a list of people or companies that are not trusted and should be avoided
sentence: The company was put on a {blacklist} for bribing officials.
translation: Компанию внесли в чёрный список за подкуп чиновников.

definition: a box made of thick paper for holding food or drink
sentence: Buy a {carton} of orange juice and a dozen eggs.
translation: Купи пакет апельсинового сока и дюжину яиц.

definition: a trick or unusual feature used to attract attention, with little real value
sentence: The free toy is just a {gimmick} to sell more cereal.
translation: Бесплатная игрушка — просто уловка, чтобы продать больше хлопьев.

definition: a doctor for animals
sentence: The {veterinarian} gave the puppy its first injection.
translation: Ветеринар сделал щенку первую прививку.

definition: a chemical found in chalk, shells and some rocks
sentence: Shells are made mostly of calcium {carbonate}.
translation: Ракушки состоят в основном из карбоната кальция.

definition: a printed sheet given to people at a lesson or meeting
sentence: The teacher gave each student a {handout} with the key dates.
translation: Учитель раздал каждому ученику листок с ключевыми датами.

definition: a person who studies religion and the nature of God
sentence: The {theologian} wrote a long book about the meaning of evil.
translation: Теолог написал длинную книгу о смысле зла.

definition: one of the two organs in a woman's body that produce eggs
sentence: The doctor found a small cyst on her left {ovary}.
translation: Врач нашёл небольшую кисту на её левом яичнике.
