definition: to walk in a proud way with your chest out, to be noticed
sentence: The rooster began to {strut} around the yard.
translation: Петух принялся важно расхаживать по двору.

definition: a belief that some things bring luck or bad luck, not based on reason
sentence: It is a common {superstition} that a black cat brings bad luck.
translation: Распространённое суеверие, что чёрная кошка приносит несчастье.

definition: to make a low, angry sound in the throat, used of dogs and people
sentence: The dog began to {growl} when the stranger came closer.
translation: Собака зарычала, когда незнакомец подошёл ближе.

definition: to correct something that is wrong
sentence: The bank promised to {rectify} the error within two days.
translation: Банк пообещал исправить ошибку в течение двух дней.

definition: a sudden period of uncontrolled anger, especially in a child
sentence: The toddler threw a {tantrum} in the middle of the shop.
translation: Малыш закатил истерику посреди магазина.

definition: a very large warship with big guns and heavy armor
sentence: The old {battleship} is now a museum in the harbor.
translation: Старый линкор теперь музей в гавани.

definition: a painful open sore on the skin or inside the body, often the stomach
sentence: Stress and painkillers gave him a stomach {ulcer}.
translation: Стресс и обезболивающие вызвали у него язву желудка.

definition: the narrow end of a pipe or hose that directs the flow
sentence: Turn the {nozzle} to change the spray from a jet to a mist.
translation: Поверни насадку, чтобы сменить струю на распыление.

definition: to become part of a group or country, or to fully understand new information
sentence: The new immigrants were expected to {assimilate} quickly.
translation: От новых иммигрантов ждали, что они быстро ассимилируются.

definition: a dark red root that is cooked and eaten, often in soup
sentence: The soup gets its deep red color from {beet}.
translation: Суп получает свой тёмно-красный цвет от свёклы.

definition: a medicine used to treat depression
sentence: Her doctor prescribed an {antidepressant} for six months.
translation: Её врач выписал антидепрессант на шесть месяцев.

definition: a piece of paper or plastic that covers something you buy, such as sweets
sentence: He dropped the chocolate {wrapper} on the pavement.
translation: Он бросил обёртку от шоколадки на тротуар.

definition: to give up power, a position or something you own
sentence: The king refused to {relinquish} his throne to his son.
translation: Король отказался уступить трон сыну.

definition: the period of life between being a child and being an adult
sentence: Many friendships formed in {adolescence} last a lifetime.
translation: Многие дружбы, возникшие в юности, длятся всю жизнь.

definition: a life that some people believe continues after death
sentence: Ancient Egyptians prepared carefully for the {afterlife}.
translation: Древние египтяне тщательно готовились к загробной жизни.

definition: a gas with a strong, sharp smell, used in cleaning products and fertilizers
sentence: The cleaning fluid smelled strongly of {ammonia}.
translation: Чистящая жидкость сильно пахла аммиаком.

definition: similar in some ways so that a comparison can be made
sentence: The heart is {analogous} to a pump in a central heating system.
translation: Сердце аналогично насосу в системе центрального отопления.

definition: a cloth worn over the front of your clothes to keep them clean
sentence: She tied on an {apron} before starting the bread.
translation: Она надела фартук, прежде чем приняться за хлеб.

definition: very old or old-fashioned, no longer used
sentence: The law uses {archaic} words that nobody understands today.
translation: Закон использует архаичные слова, которых сегодня никто не понимает.

definition: the act of saying who made, wrote or caused something
sentence: The painting's {attribution} to Rembrandt is now doubted.
translation: Приписывание картины Рембрандту теперь ставится под сомнение.

definition: the study of the chemical processes in living things
sentence: She left medicine to do a PhD in {biochemistry}.
translation: Она ушла из медицины, чтобы писать диссертацию по биохимии.

definition: the day or year exactly one hundred years after an event
sentence: The town celebrated the {centennial} of its railway station.
translation: Город отметил столетие своего вокзала.

definition: a small plant with three round leaves, common in grass
sentence: She searched the lawn for a four-leaf {clover}.
translation: Она искала на лужайке четырёхлистный клевер.

definition: the act of taking control of an area and sending people to live there
sentence: The {colonization} of the Americas changed the world's food.
translation: Колонизация Америки изменила еду всего мира.

definition: containing people and cultures from many parts of the world
sentence: London is a {cosmopolitan} city where every language is spoken.
translation: Лондон — космополитичный город, где звучит любой язык.

definition: able to be taken away from the total before tax is calculated
sentence: Travel costs for work are {deductible} from your income tax.
translation: Расходы на деловые поездки вычитаются из подоходного налога.

definition: going in a straight line from one corner to the opposite corner
sentence: Draw a {diagonal} line across the square.
translation: Проведи диагональную линию через квадрат.

definition: a tall box with drawers in a bedroom, where you keep your clothes
sentence: She keeps her sweaters in the top drawer of the {dresser}.
translation: Она хранит свитера в верхнем ящике комода.

definition: not working normally, used of families, organizations or relationships
sentence: He grew up in a {dysfunctional} family and left home at sixteen.
translation: Он вырос в неблагополучной семье и ушёл из дома в шестнадцать.

definition: fair and reasonable to everyone involved
sentence: The judge sought an {equitable} division of the property.
translation: Судья стремился к справедливому разделу имущества.

definition: a female hormone that controls the development of the body and the menstrual cycle
sentence: Levels of {estrogen} fall sharply after the menopause.
translation: Уровень эстрогена резко падает после менопаузы.

definition: relating to the medieval system in which peasants worked land owned by lords
sentence: Under the {feudal} system, farmers owed labor to their lord.
translation: При феодальной системе крестьяне были обязаны трудом своему господину.

definition: the wool of a sheep, or a soft warm jacket made of artificial material
sentence: Put on a {fleece}; it gets cold on the hill after sunset.
translation: Надень флиску, на холме после заката холодно.

definition: food for farm animals such as cows and horses
sentence: The barn was full of {fodder} for the winter.
translation: Амбар был полон корма на зиму.

definition: a person who enjoys and knows a lot about good food and drink
sentence: As a {gourmet}, he plans his holidays around restaurants.
translation: Как гурман, он планирует отпуск вокруг ресторанов.

definition: small enough to be held and used in one hand
sentence: The inspector carried a {handheld} scanner for the tickets.
translation: Контролёр носил портативный сканер для билетов.

definition: the act of holding and shaking someone's hand as a greeting or agreement
sentence: The deal was sealed with a {handshake}, not a contract.
translation: Сделку скрепили рукопожатием, а не контрактом.

definition: large and heavy, or large in amount
sentence: The bank charges a {hefty} fee for late payments.
translation: Банк берёт внушительную плату за просрочку.

definition: made from plants, especially those used in medicine or cooking
sentence: She drinks {herbal} tea instead of coffee in the evening.
translation: Вечером она пьёт травяной чай вместо кофе.

definition: extremely stupid
sentence: Driving without lights at night was an {idiotic} thing to do.
translation: Ехать ночью без фар было идиотским поступком.

definition: the state of being kept in prison
sentence: The country has the highest rate of {incarceration} in the world.
translation: В этой стране самый высокий уровень тюремного заключения в мире.

definition: sex between close relatives, which is illegal in most countries
sentence: The laws against {incest} go back thousands of years.
translation: Законы против инцеста существуют тысячи лет.

definition: the act of putting something into something else
sentence: The {insertion} of a new paragraph changed the meaning of the letter.
translation: Вставка нового абзаца изменила смысл письма.

definition: a structure of crossed strips of wood or metal with spaces between them
sentence: Roses climbed up the wooden {lattice} by the door.
translation: Розы вились по деревянной решётке у двери.

definition: in a way that is allowed by law or that is reasonable
sentence: The company says it {legitimately} earned every dollar.
translation: Компания утверждает, что законно заработала каждый доллар.

definition: as if by magic; in a surprising way that cannot be explained
sentence: The pain {magically} disappeared after one injection.
translation: Боль волшебным образом исчезла после одного укола.

definition: a person who plans and organizes a difficult or clever project, often a crime
sentence: Police believe she was the {mastermind} behind the bank robbery.
translation: Полиция считает, что она была мозгом ограбления банка.

definition: in a way that is important or makes a real difference
sentence: The new evidence does not {materially} change the case.
translation: Новые доказательства существенно не меняют дело.

definition: information that describes other data, such as the date a photo was taken
sentence: The photo's {metadata} showed where and when it was taken.
translation: Метаданные фотографии показали, где и когда она снята.

definition: bad behavior that causes trouble but no serious harm, often by children
sentence: The twins are always up to some {mischief} in the garden.
translation: Близнецы вечно затевают какую-нибудь шалость в саду.

definition: the process of making something more modern
sentence: The {modernization} of the railway took fifteen years.
translation: Модернизация железной дороги заняла пятнадцать лет.

definition: in a way that is easy to see or notice
sentence: The days are getting {noticeably} shorter now.
translation: Дни теперь заметно укорачиваются.

definition: the use of a room or building, or how full it is
sentence: The hotel reported ninety percent {occupancy} in August.
translation: Отель сообщил о девяностопроцентной заполняемости в августе.

definition: the study and treatment of cancer
sentence: She works as a nurse in the {oncology} ward.
translation: Она работает медсестрой в онкологическом отделении.

definition: to spread over a place in large numbers and fill it
sentence: Weeds will {overrun} the garden if you leave it for a month.
translation: Сорняки заполонят сад, если оставить его на месяц.

definition: caused by or relating to disease, or impossible to control
sentence: He is a {pathological} liar who cannot tell the truth even about lunch.
translation: Он патологический лжец, не способный сказать правду даже про обед.

definition: directly connected with the subject being discussed
sentence: The lawyer asked a {pertinent} question about the time of the call.
translation: Адвокат задал уместный вопрос о времени звонка.

definition: existing in large amounts; more than enough
sentence: Fish are {plentiful} in the lake in early summer.
translation: В начале лета в озере много рыбы.

definition: something that is unusual and not found often
sentence: Snow in April is a {rarity} in this part of Spain.
translation: Снег в апреле — редкость в этой части Испании.

definition: refusing to obey rules or authority
sentence: As a {rebellious} teenager, he dyed his hair green.
translation: Будучи бунтующим подростком, он покрасил волосы в зелёный.

definition: using humor to criticize people, politics or society
sentence: The {satirical} magazine makes fun of every politician.
translation: Сатирический журнал высмеивает каждого политика.

definition: relating to physical pleasure, especially of the body
sentence: The dance was slow and {sensual}.
translation: Танец был медленным и чувственным.

definition: small in number or amount and spread over a large area
sentence: Trees are {sparse} on the high plateau.
translation: На высоком плато деревья редки.

definition: the force that pulls air or liquid out of a space
sentence: The vacuum cleaner has lost its {suction}.
translation: Пылесос потерял всасывание.

definition: added to something to improve or complete it
sentence: The course includes {supplementary} reading for interested students.
translation: Курс включает дополнительное чтение для заинтересованных студентов.

definition: a person's nature, which affects how they behave and feel
sentence: She has a calm {temperament} and rarely gets angry.
translation: У неё спокойный темперамент, и она редко злится.

definition: coming after twelve others in order
sentence: Friday the {thirteenth} is thought to be an unlucky day.
translation: Пятница тринадцатое считается несчастливым днём.

definition: not pleasant to look at, or not interesting or desirable
sentence: The offer was {unattractive} because of the long contract.
translation: Предложение было непривлекательным из-за долгого контракта.

definition: not having lost any game or match
sentence: The team is {unbeaten} in twelve matches this season.
translation: Команда не проигрывает уже двенадцать матчей в этом сезоне.

definition: a statement that makes something seem less important or serious than it is
sentence: To call the storm "bad weather" is an {understatement}.
translation: Назвать бурю «плохой погодой» — это преуменьшение.

definition: not wanted because it is bad or harmful
sentence: The drug has some {undesirable} side effects.
translation: У препарата есть нежелательные побочные эффекты.

definition: in a way that is not fair or just
sentence: She felt she had been {unfairly} blamed for the accident.
translation: Она чувствовала, что её несправедливо обвинили в аварии.

definition: the process of joining separate things or countries into one
sentence: The {unification} of Germany took place in 1990.
translation: Объединение Германии произошло в 1990 году.

definition: water that has been used in homes or factories and contains waste
sentence: The plant cleans the city's {wastewater} before it reaches the river.
translation: Станция очищает городские сточные воды, прежде чем они попадут в реку.

definition: weapons of a particular type or belonging to a group
sentence: The rebels have modern {weaponry} from abroad.
translation: У повстанцев современное вооружение из-за рубежа.

definition: a single page of text and pictures on a website
sentence: The {webpage} took a minute to load on the slow connection.
translation: Веб-страница грузилась минуту на медленном соединении.

definition: a funny drawing or description that exaggerates someone's features
sentence: The artist drew a {caricature} of the mayor with a huge nose.
translation: Художник нарисовал карикатуру на мэра с огромным носом.

definition: to come apart or undo a knot or threads, or to explain something complicated
sentence: Detectives slowly began to {unravel} the mystery of the missing money.
translation: Детективы постепенно начали распутывать тайну пропавших денег.

definition: to fill something again after it has been emptied
sentence: The waiter came back to {refill} our glasses.
translation: Официант вернулся, чтобы снова наполнить наши бокалы.

definition: to go beyond the usual limits of something
sentence: Her music seems to {transcend} the borders between jazz and classical.
translation: Её музыка словно выходит за границы между джазом и классикой.

definition: a common idea or image used again and again in stories or films
sentence: The haunted house is a familiar {trope} in horror films.
translation: Дом с привидениями — привычный штамп в фильмах ужасов.

definition: a person who tries to reach an agreement between two sides
sentence: The police {negotiator} talked to the gunman for six hours.
translation: Полицейский переговорщик шесть часов говорил с вооружённым человеком.

definition: a small area of one country or group that is surrounded by another
sentence: The city is a Spanish {enclave} on the coast of Africa.
translation: Город — испанский анклав на побережье Африки.

definition: to do something again, usually because it was not good enough
sentence: The teacher made him {redo} the whole essay.
translation: Учитель заставил его переделать всё эссе.

definition: to explode or make a bomb explode
sentence: Engineers will {detonate} the old bridge at dawn.
translation: Инженеры взорвут старый мост на рассвете.

definition: to lift something heavy with ropes or a machine
sentence: The sailors began to {hoist} the sails as the wind rose.
translation: Матросы начали поднимать паруса, когда ветер усилился.

definition: a sloping position, or a way of presenting information that favors one side
sentence: The newspaper gives a clear political {slant} to every story.
translation: Газета придаёт каждой истории явный политический уклон.

definition: to open your mouth wide and breathe in because you are tired or bored
sentence: The lecture made half the room {yawn}.
translation: От лекции полкомнаты зевало.

definition: to pay back money that someone has spent for you
sentence: The company will {reimburse} your travel expenses within a month.
translation: Компания возместит ваши дорожные расходы в течение месяца.

definition: something done only because the rules require it, or polite formal behavior
sentence: The interview was a {formality}; the job was already hers.
translation: Собеседование было формальностью, работа уже была её.

definition: a person believed to have the power to speak to spirits and heal people
sentence: The {shaman} beat a drum and sang to cure the sick child.
translation: Шаман бил в бубен и пел, чтобы вылечить больного ребёнка.

definition: an unusual habit or feature that makes someone or something different
sentence: One {quirk} of the house is that the stairs lead nowhere.
translation: Одна странность дома в том, что лестница ведёт в никуда.

definition: a flat that you own in a building of flats owned by different people
sentence: They bought a {condominium} with a view of the bay.
translation: Они купили кондоминиум с видом на залив.

definition: a small glass bottle for medicine or liquids
sentence: The nurse filled the needle from a tiny {vial}.
translation: Медсестра наполнила иглу из крошечного флакона.
